note: The Letters of the Living attained the presence of the Báb in Shíráz — all but Ṭáhirih (GPB: 'unlike her fellow-disciples, never attained the presence of the Báb').
proof: attained the presence of the Báb and were declared “Letters of the Living.”

exceptions.proof: unlike her fellow-disciples, never attained the presence of the Báb
